newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline trims gains despite sharp crude rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline trims gains despite sharp crude rally.

text.p: NWE gasoline trimmed its gains late on Wednesday but were still firmly elevated by rallying crude oil futures and recent cargo activity to the U.K. and U.S., traders said.
No cargo trades were seen on Wednesday after Tuesday's 10,000 tonnes into the Thames at $229.50 cif, but there was still interest near that level.
That buyer was visible in the Eurograde barge market this morning but traders said its support for prices started to diminish this afternoon.
"There still seems to be some buyers interested into the Thames...but you can't tell if it's genuine or not," said one trader.
Some believed the arbitrage was still open to the U.S. after NYMEX gasoline jumped sharply today.
Tonight's American Petroleum Institute report was expected to provide a clue for prices Thursday.
Regular unleaded barges traded at $210.50 and was at $210/$212 in late action, up $2 and narrowing its discount to premium unleaded by about $2.
